title: Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Freestanding Floor Stand Solid Brass 2X/1X Double-Sided | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Get a clear, close-up view for makeup or shaving without sacrificing a full-face check in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. This freestanding, floor-standing make-up mirror features double-sided mirror glass with 2X magnification on one side and 1X on the other for everyday grooming at a comfortable angle—an easy fit for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Place it anywhere in the bathroom: freestanding floor stand design requires no wall mounting
- Feel steady during use: heavy solid brass base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Protect countertops and floors: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding floor standing make-up mirror
- Mirror: 8-Inch diameter, double faced mirror glass
- Magnification: 2X on one side, 1X on the other
- Material: Brass construction
- Overall dimensions (L x W): 10.5 in x 10.5 in
- Weight: 13.6 lb
- Included: Make-up mirror
- Assembly: Required
, including 25 options and statement colors to coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures.
